  "concordance_definition": "The paper does not explicitly define a concordance definition but discusses face validity, construct validity, and predictive validity. Predictive validity is described as the ability of animal models to provide information that translates to the human situation. For example, pharmacological opioid-receptor blockade reducing alcohol consumption in rats and mice, which translates to the human situation where the opioid-receptor blocker nalmefene also reduces alcohol consumption. The incubation model of drug craving is stated to have high face, construct, and predictive validity due to direct translation to human situations (smokers, alcoholics, cocaine addicts). The alcohol-deprivation-effect model for relapse is stated to provide excellent face validity to relapse behavior seen in alcoholics. The multisymptomatic 0/3crit model of cocaine addiction is described as aiming to identify subpopulations of rats possessing vulnerability and resilience toward cocaine-addiction-like behavior, which is intended to correlate with human addiction.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "Many preclinically validated mechanisms fail during clinical development.",
    "Rigor of preclinical data is often low (lack of randomization, blinding, sample-size calculations).",
    "Generalizability of preclinical data is often not considered (laboratory conditions, animal strains, age, sex, long-term drug administration, tolerance development).",
    "Concerns about clinical trial design (divergences in outcomes, insufficient target engagement, low dosing, augmented placebo effects).",
    "Animal models of voluntary drug intake and addiction models based on DSM may not be suitable for complex human mental disorders like schizophrenia.",
    "Face validity can be a result of anthropomorphic interpretations.",
    "Oral self-administration of drugs like cannabis, nicotine, cocaine, or opioids may not accurately model human use due to different pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics compared to inhalation or intravenous administration.",
    "Genetically selected animal strains for high alcohol consumption reduce data generalizability and may not translate well to the human situation.",
    "Intermittent alcohol vapor exposure lacks face validity for the human drinking situation and may produce false-positive signals.",
    "The reinstatement model of drug-seeking has questionable predictive validity; human addicts do not typically undergo extinction, and subjects do not relapse (resume drug consumption) in the model.",
    "Modeling the entire spectrum of a complex human mental disorder like addiction in animals is not possible.",
    "The multisymptomatic model of cocaine addiction has not been successfully established in mice.",
    "Mice can sometimes produce paradoxical drug effects when compared with humans.",
    "Intracranial self-stimulation is a test procedure that does not have a direct resemblance to the human situation and cannot be considered an animal model of drug use or addiction.",
    "The possible relevance of drug-induced sensitization in humans is still unclear."
  ],
